name: ego-lite
description: Verified web research routing and browser automation through ego lite.

interface.shortDescription: Route research and verify live web pages
interface.longDescription: Use Codex to automatically route public web research through the best available search layer and use ego-browser for live, dynamic, authenticated, or interactive verification. Also navigate websites, fill forms, capture screenshots, extract structured data, and test web apps in isolated ego lite task spaces.
defaultPrompt: Research this thoroughly and verify important claims against the live website when useful.
Compare the current official policy with what the real page shows and resolve conflicts.
Open a website and complete a browser task for me.
